purpose: The release qualification design for the Q01-family critic configuration. Frozen before any release-heldout material exists or is read. It is a scoped acceptance rule for one exact configuration on one sealed set, not a general capability claim.

configuration_under_test.binding: Fixed in the run plan that executes this design; any change to an identity field is a new configuration and needs a new sealed run.
configuration_under_test.critic_prompt_digest_source: app/services/design_criticism_live.render_criticism_prompt system part, per purpose, with the stage instruction appended by the harness

dataset.must_be_new: No case, material, candidate, counterexample or wording from evals/deeptwin/q01_materials.py, q01_lenses.json or the ten calibration cases, and no paraphrase of them.

authoring.author: A person or process that has not seen the verifier's expectations for the calibration cases and does not tune the critic configuration. The developer who built the Q01 harness and verifier is excluded.
authoring.expectations: Written by the author from the new materials alone, before any trial, and sealed (content sha256 recorded, file access limited to the verifier).
authoring.review: A second reviewer checks each expectation against the materials before sealing; disagreements are resolved or the case is dropped, never averaged.

composition.note: A scoped design choice for release-v1 so every class has more than one instance; it is not a statistical sample size and supports no rate estimate.

access.before_run: Only the author, the reviewer and the sealing step read the set.
access.during_run: Agent inputs come only from the harness's allowlisted reader; expectations are read only by the verifier; every read is logged.
access.after_run: The set becomes observed; any later change to the configuration makes it development data, never heldout again.

execution.invalid_trials: reported with their cause, never scored, never replaced within the same run
execution.spend: a hard USD stop fixed in the executing run plan before any call; a stopped run is incomplete

acceptance.case_pass: a case passes only if every one of its repetitions is valid and passes under the frozen verifier
acceptance.incomplete: any case with fewer valid repetitions than planned makes the suite incomplete (no verdict), never a pass
acceptance.judge_dependence: semantic items count only under an independence profile whose independence_established is true; otherwise they are not_judged and the suite cannot pass

claims_if_passed: This exact configuration met the frozen acceptance rule on this sealed set, in these repetitions.
never_claimed: an error rate, false-rejection rate or missed-defect rate beyond the observed counts
generalization to other tasks or materials
statistical independence of critic and judge beyond what the independence profile states
